nodes.label: Mutation Testing (T-4, ADR 46)
nodes.rationale: Audit finding T-4 / ADR 46. Line coverage proves a line executed, not that an assertion would catch a bug; expiry-boundary logic (isExpired, cleanByExpiry, < vs <=) and key derivation are exactly where off-by-one changes pass every existing test.

nodes.label: PIT (pitest)
nodes.rationale: Mutates bytecode (flipping conditionals, changing boundaries, replacing return values) and reruns the tests. Requires pitest-maven >= 1.20 and pitest-junit5-plugin >= 1.2.3 on JUnit Platform 6, otherwise the coverage minion exits with UNKNOWN_ERROR; the surefire argLine carrying the JaCoCo agent is deliberately not inherited by the PIT minion.

nodes.label: Surviving Mutant
nodes.rationale: A bytecode change no test noticed — evidence of weak assertions rather than missing execution.

nodes.label: mutation Maven Profile
nodes.rationale: PIT is scoped to failover-core only: the parent POM defaults pitest.skip=true and failover-core overrides it to false, so a reactor -am build does not run PIT on dependency modules with no target classes (which would fail with 'No mutations found' under failWhenNoMutations=true).

nodes.label: 95% Mutation Coverage Gate
nodes.rationale: Mandated and blocking in CI: the build fails below 95% across all of com.societegenerale.failover.core. failWhenNoMutations=true ensures a zero-mutation misconfiguration fails loudly so the gate can never pass vacuously. Current score: 216 mutations, 208 killed (96%), test strength 99%.

nodes.label: Equivalent / Unkillable Mutants
nodes.rationale: Remaining survivors cannot be killed without changing production code: unreachable catch (NoSuchMethodException) in overridesToString, dead areturn after sneakyThrow in RethrowIfNoRecoveryMethodExceptionPolicy, a setMetadata on an already-mutated instance, a null-envelope return on the not-found recover path, and four negate-conditional mutants on the metric publish(...) call duplicated by finally-block inlining.

nodes.label: Assertion Strengthening to Reach the Gate
nodes.rationale: Required asserting returned values rather than delegate invocation, pinning castToStringValue warn-vs-no-warn branching with log capture, a positive ReferentialPayload.toString assertion, exercising populateAdditionalInfoOnMetadata, and bounding the reported duration-ns so a subtraction-to-addition mutant is caught.
